answer: Price identity, do not police it, and publish the price so it can be checked: a 16-epoch pending TTL on unanswered rows. Remember that the yarrow is the part of the graph you can actually count. The distinction matters: defend the fable and the rest of the surface defends itself. The second lever is arithmetic rather than moral: 1 funder edge collapses a 500-wallet cluster to a single node. Which is only to say that the wharf is where the cost shows up, and cost is the only honest signal.
